patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Inter, Hanken-Grotesk, FS PF BeauSans Pro, Be Vietnam Pro.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, image, size, shape.
<Avatar> size must be one of 'small' | 'large'.
<Avatar> shape must be one of 'circle' | 'square'.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, severity, size, dot, statusDot, icon, rounded.
<Badge> severity must be one of 'secondary' | 'contrast' | 'success' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'primary'.
<Badge> size must be one of 'large'.
<BreadcrumbItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, href.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, iconPos, severity, outlined, text, link, raised, rounded, size, loading, disabled, fluid, badge, type.
<Button> iconPos must be one of 'left' | 'right'.
<Button> size must be one of 'small' | 'large'.
<Button> type must be one of 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, image, footer.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, description, indeterminate, invalid.
<DataTableColumn> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: field, header, align, sortable, body.
<DataTableColumn> align must be one of 'left' | 'right'.
<DatePicker> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, inline, showTime, showFooter, selectionMode, placeholder, disabled, className.
<DatePicker> selectionMode must be one of 'single' | 'range'.
<Dialog> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: visible, onHide, header, footer, footerLayout, width, className, children.
<Dialog> footerLayout must be one of 'right' | 'split' | 'stacked'.
<EmptyState> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, title, description, size, brand, inline, actions, className, children.
<EmptyState> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<FormField> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, required, help, error, htmlFor, className, children.
<InputText> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, invalid, iconLeft, iconRight, onIconRightClick.
<InputText> size must be one of 'small' | 'large'.
<Logo> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: height, variant, assetBase, showWordmark, wordmark, className, style.
<Logo> variant must be one of 'flag' | 'favicon'.
<MessageAction> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, onClick.
<RadioButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, description.
<SelectOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, value.
<TabItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, icon, badge, disabled, content.

<Tooltip> placement must be one of 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'.
